analysis.title: GS Callahan - GS US TMT quick hits + stocks 13 Nov 2026
key_insights: NDX futures were up 20 bps pre-market despite a risk-off KOSPI fade overnight. The author says markets are absorbing several headwinds: NVDA losing about $500bn of market cap week to date, VIX in the high 18s, Brent near $96, the 10-year at 5.13%, US home sales at the lowest since 2010, and a surging USD. He attributes the resilience to cleaner positioning and rotation into large-cap Tech, Defensives, Low Vol and Pharma.

NVDA bounced off about $150 on Thursday morning, roughly 10x CY27 consensus GAAP EPS of about $15.60. More than 22mn shares traded pre-market, and nearly 2bn shares have traded since Monday, about 8% of the float. The author reads the action as 'time (volume) rather than price'.

AMD and AVGO have outperformed NVDA by 35-40 points on the week. NVDA shed about $500bn of market cap while AVGO and AMD combined added about $500bn. The author thinks AMD and ANET are the only AI supply chain stocks at or near 52-week highs. The debate is now over the next leg in Semis and Compute.
NVDA reports next week. GIR estimates are largely in line with the Street, with GSe F3Q revenue of about $110bn and F4Q revenue of about $124.8bn.

Security names face a busy stretch of off-quarter prints (ZS, PANW, OKTA, CRWD). Most high-flyer data infrastructure and security names (FTNT, DT, TWLO, DDOG, CHKP) have failed to beat elevated expectations. ZS is down 11 of 13 days.

Cisco called out Security as a bright spot. Security orders excluding Splunk rose 15% y/y and firewall orders rose more than 30% for the third straight quarter. Cisco cited a more competitive firewall portfolio, a natural refresh cycle in which customers evaluate alternatives, and large customers swapping out competitor firewalls.

CSCO was unchanged pre-market after a headline beat and raise driven by AI/hyperscaler and campus networking upside. Product orders decelerated to +21% y/y (+14% ex-webscale AI) from +35% (+25% ex-webscale AI) last quarter, and there is ongoing debate on gross margins, mostly from mix. Investor feedback was tame, which the author links to balanced positioning. GIR goes to about $5 of GAAP EPS in FY28.

AMAT trades at 14x GIR's CY28 EPS estimate of about $27, against a 10-year average 12-month forward P/E of about 17x. The open question is whether Semicap can decouple from concerns in the memory complex, and whether memory is the better play given its valuation discount. GIR is positive on market share gains as WFE growth accelerates in 2027.
GIR forecasts WFE growth accelerating to about 45% y/y in 2027, with AMAT benefiting from over 60% exposure to deposition and etch.

Industrial AI names: GIR says reductions to AI-exposed revenue and EPS are likely already more than priced into electronics components and test coverage. Even with a 45% revenue reduction to datacenter-exposed sales, APH, KEYS, TEL and BDC show upside or limited downside to implied price. APH and KEYS are top ideas.

GIR says EMS and Power names with more revenue tied to AI infrastructure (VRT, FLEX, JBL) could see larger estimate reductions in downside scenarios. Some reduction already appears priced in, even at pre-AI-build-out multiples. GIR still argues higher multiples than history are often merited given cycle-to-cycle margin and EPS growth improvement.

Investors are debating whether to buy the most AI/DC-exposed names (VRT, FLEX, JBL, APH) on the view that AI cycle concerns are overstated, or rotate into more diversified names (BDC, TEL) that could hold up better in a choppier, less exponential path.

The GS Econ/GIR 2027 Global Equity Strategy outlook says attractive opportunities are emerging in long-duration Growth companies as growth rates slow. It names US Hyperscalers, which still have strong though slower earnings growth and strong balance sheets.

tension_points.bull_case: GIR says AI-exposed revenue and EPS cuts are already more than priced into electronics components and test names. Even with a 45% datacenter revenue cut, APH, KEYS, TEL and BDC show upside or limited downside, so buy the most AI-exposed names on a view that cycle concerns are overstated.
